en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4094 - Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Jamil ibn Darraj, who said that

Abu Abdullah (as) was asked about a man who gave collateral (rahn) to another man, but the collateral was lost.
Imam (as) said: "It is the responsibility of the pledger (rahin), and the pledgee (murtahin) has the right to claim his money from him."
